question: Can an offline reinforcement learner route each instrument to a forecasting model, using market context and only feedback available by its decision date?
history: 2023–2025 and the custom mixture comparisons already examined. Exploratory successor. No model promotion. No hyperparameter search.
action: Choose one expert identity from the pool at each close; use that model's complete three-class probability vector. The same existing trading rule converts every method's forecast into positions.
reward: Offline negative categorical log loss of the selected five-session forecast less 0.01 log-loss units when changing the previous day's expert. The switch preference is a model-routing penalty, distinct from trading fees. A uniform initial previous-action penalty of zero each symbol-year.
learner: Eight steps of offline fitted Q iteration with discount 0.9 and linear ridge regularization 100. Predict the return of each candidate before applying the known previous-action penalty. Market states are exogenous to the model choice. Reset at each instrument-year end; target transitions span adjacent archived decisions for the same instrument only. Full-information fitting evaluates each expert's archived probability against the matured label.
state: Seven decision-time market and qualitative features plus per-symbol mean expert log loss across the latest 21 published outcomes, using only endpoints strictly before the decision. Default loss log(3) with no feedback. Standardize and clip to +/-10 using training rows only.
folds: Train 2023 through its completed endpoints, test 2024; train 2023–2024 through their completed endpoints, test 2025. Remove training rows whose endpoints reach the first test decision. Later realized outcomes enter rolling context only after maturity. No held-out model refit. Overlapping five-session outcomes produce dependent rewards. They are unavailable as contemporaneous inputs.
primary: Paired mean daily forecast loss difference (RL model router minus fixed learned mixture) for full pool. 95% within-year 21-session circular block bootstrap, seed 28, 2,000 draws. Portfolio performance and alternative pools descriptive.
execution: Unchanged five-session gain threshold, inverse-volatility sizing, position caps, next opening, common annual liquidations, starting USD 10000 and 5 bps per side.
